summary: Confirmed on koa.com and its booking form: reservable online, water and sewer; added $145-269 (mid-June 2027 weeknight, before tax), 50-amp, 75-ft max with pull-thrus, showers/laundry/store/Wi-Fi, season May 1 - Oct 15. Phone 406-387-5341 confirmed. Not stated: site count, Good Sam/military discounts (derived values left). Note trimmed of the price and rating lines.
